title: Pan-Seared Algerian Brochette Steak
description: A flavorful Algerian-inspired dish featuring pan-seared steak brochette, perfect for a romantic dinner.

ingredients.name: steak
ingredients.notes: preferably flank steak or skirt steak

ingredients.name: algerian spice blend
ingredients.notes: or substitute with a combination of cumin, coriander, and paprika

instructions: 1. In a large bowl, whisk together algerian spice blend, garlic, salt, and black pepper.
2. Add the steak to the marinade and mix well to coat. Cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight.
3. Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
4. Remove the steak from the marinade and brush with olive oil.
5. Grill the steak for 4-5 minutes per side, or until it reaches your desired level of doneness.
6. Let the steak rest for 5 minutes before slicing it thinly against the grain.
7. Meanwhile, warm the pita bread by wrapping it in foil and heating it in the oven at 350°F (180°C) for 5 minutes.
8. Slice the warm pita bread in half lengthwise and toast for an additional 2-3 minutes.
9. To assemble the brochette, thread the sliced steak onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
10. Brush the brochette with olive oil and grill for an additional 2-3 minutes, or until lightly charred.
11. Serve the brochette with warm pita bread, crispy onions, lemon wedges, and a sprinkle of chopped parsley.
